Column.description: One column of a BOM or CPL file.

header.description: The column header, such as "LCSC Part #".

ColumnSource.description: Where a BOM or CPL column takes its values from.

oneOf.description: The Designators of the row, in natural order (CPL: the one Designator).
How many Components the BOM row groups.
The Footprint's centre, X, in mm from the CPL origin.
The Footprint's centre, Y, in mm from the CPL origin.
The Footprint's rotation in degrees, counter-clockwise.
The Component field with this name, such as `LCSC` or `MPN`.

path.description:
The Document's file name, relative to the Project folder; its stem is the
Document's name and its extension its kind.

ErcSeverities.description:
The severity of every ERC check, stored in the Project. A check left out has its
default.

dangling_wire.description: A Wire end that touches nothing.

duplicate_designator.description: Several Components with the same Designator.

no_connect_connected.description: A No-Connect Marker on a Pin that is connected.

pin_conflict.description: Drivers fighting on a Net: Output and Power Out Pins together.

pin_conflict_mixed.description: Pin types that should not mix on a Net, such as Tri-state and Output.

single_pin_net.description: A wired Net with only one Pin.

single_sheet_port.description: A Port whose name no other sheet has.

unattached_label.description: A Net Label or Port attached to nothing.

unconnected_input.description: An Input or Power In Pin connected to nothing.

unconnected_pin.description:
A Pin of another type connected to nothing. Not Connected Pins and Pins with a
No-Connect Marker are exempt.

undriven_power.description: A Net with Power In Pins and no Power Out Pin or Power Port.

unit_data_mismatch.description: Units of one Component whose Component data differ.

unplaced_units.description: Units of a placed multi-unit Component left unplaced.

FileNaming.description: How the Gerber and drill files of a job are named.

oneOf.description: Protel extensions: `.GTL`, `.GBL`, `.GTS`, … and `.GKO` for the Board Outline.

GerberSettings.description: The Gerber and drill switches of a Fab Preset.

x2_attributes.description: Write Gerber X2 attributes (`.FileFunction` and friends); off writes plain X1.

OutputJob.description: A named recipe for manufacturing files, stored in the Project file.

destination.description:
The output folder relative to the Project folder, `/`-separated; left out for
`outputs/<job name>`.

fab_preset.description: The Project copy of the Fab Preset it uses.

pcb.description:
The PCB Document it plots. A job whose PCB Document is gone is broken until it is
pointed at another.

Outputs.description: Which files an Output Job writes.

drill.description: Excellon drill files, plated and non-plated.

gerber.description: Gerber files for copper, mask, paste, silkscreen and the Board Outline.

ProjectFabPreset.description:
The Project's own copy of a Fab Preset, so outputs come out the same on any machine.
Its fields are a [`FabPreset`]'s, after the UUID.

name.description: The name of the preset it was copied from.

ProjectProperties.description:
The Project properties: fixed free-text fields that fill each sheet's title block, and
the board thickness and copper weight that go into fab notes.

board_thickness.description: The finished board thickness, for fab notes; left out when not set.

copper_weight.description: The copper weight, for fab notes, as free text such as `1 oz`; left out when empty.

Rules.description:
The board-wide minimum values that DRC checks against.

Net Classes override some of them per Net. Later per-Layer or per-area rules (and a rule
query language) are meant to be new object kinds that override these values in a
scope, so this set stays the board-wide fallback.

annular_ring.description: Minimum annular ring of Vias and plated Pads.

clearance.description: Minimum clearance between copper of different Nets.

edge_clearance.description: Minimum clearance from copper to the Board Outline and Board Cutouts.

Severity.description: How a check's Violations are reported.

description: A REDA Project file (`.reda`). The Project's name is the file stem.

documents.description: The Project's Documents, in Project order (sheet numbering, PDF output).

erc.description:
The ERC severities, `error`, `warning` or `off` per check. Written only when any
differs from its default; a check left out has its default.

fab_presets.description:
The Project's copies of the Fab Presets its Output Jobs use, in the same shape as a
`.redafab` file plus a UUID.

format.description: The file-format version. REDA writes only the current one.

libraries.description:
The Project Libraries: folders relative to the Project folder, `/`-separated.
Written only when there are any.

properties.description:
The Project properties that fill the sheets' title blocks. Written only when any
is set.

title: REDA Project file
